name: labs/gridinwork__ai-oscilloscope-isds205b
title: INSTRUSTAR ISDS205B USB oscilloscope (instrustar.Scope)
intro: INSTRUSTAR ISDS205B USB oscilloscope (instrustar.Scope), adapted from gridinwork/ai-oscilloscope-isds205b. It reads `available`, `ch1_voltage_resolution_v`, `ch2_voltage_resolution_v`, `ch1_coupling_ac` and 8 more; sets `sample_rate_hz`, `generator_waveform`, `trigger_mode`, `trigger_style` and 3 more; runs `capture`, `set_input_range` and `generator_enable`. `capture`: capture one waveform on both channels and return per-channel scalar measurements. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
